title: Synchronize
subtitle: Bring the input into the chip clock
explanation: Two registers sample the asynchronous input before digital decisions are made.
detail: The synchronizer reduces metastability propagation risk. It does not clean up a bouncing mechanical contact by itself.

title: Qualify
subtitle: Require a stable level
explanation: The level must persist for the configured number of clock samples before it changes the accepted state.
detail: At a 50 MHz clock, 1–8 samples span about 20–160 ns. A mechanical reed switch needs a slower supplied clock or a future prescaler.

title: Count
subtitle: Record accepted rising edges
explanation: An accepted rising edge increments the 8-bit live count. The count saturates at 255.
detail: The same RTL counts every selected scenario; the generated raw input and filter settings change.

title: Capture
subtitle: Close the measurement window
explanation: A window tick snapshots the live count and starts the next measurement period.
detail: The demo injects a window tick after the generated waveform and reads the resulting snapshot.

title: Audit
subtitle: Expose integrity flags
explanation: The chip reports a rejected transient, a count below the configured minimum, or an 8-bit saturation event.
detail: These are digital observations in the simulated measurement window, not field sensor accuracy claims.
